text:
zoe-partners: Heads-up 1: partner feed roundup due today. Need canonical CSV with reserved/spot/floor/auction ladder + billing lag by EOD. Include regional flags and NDA masks.

marketplace-bot: export ready: https://drive.redwood.ai/partners/export-2787654321.csv :robot_face:

mike-sales: VegaCompute and Stratus sent different ladder formats. Vega gave percent multipliers, Stratus gave absolute floors+soft-floor note. I'll normalize to raw JSON in a column.

anya-eng: Ingest schema (exact columns):
partner,sku,region,reserved_usd_per_gpu_hour,spot_mean_usd_per_gpu_hour,spot_stddev,spot_90pct,eviction_24h_pct,eviction_grace_hours,min_commit_months,bid_ladder_type,bid_ladder_raw,billing_lag_days,invoice_cadence,price_masked,monthly_committed_gpu_hours,listing_id,sku_id,partner_id,latency_delta_ms,regional_embargo,embargo_note

omar-ops: Ops needs eviction_grace_hours and eviction_credit_pct. If grace >=24h, apply 24h smoothing in playbook. Also include latency_delta_ms (reserved vs spot).

jess-finance: Finance: use conservative billing_lag_days when partner gives range. Include invoice_cadence text (monthly/quarterly). Eviction credits modeled as negative cost.

mike-sales: Quick Q: partners that give only mean/stddev, do we compute spot_90pct?

anya-eng: Yes. If spot_90pct missing compute = mean + 1.28*stddev and set provenance column (not required here). Keep bid_ladder_raw as JSON string; bid_ladder_type canonicalized to {pct_multiplier|absolute_floor|soft_floor|tiered}.

zoe-partners: Also flag can_publish_agg=true/false for marketing. We will only release aggregated bands. NDA regions should set price_masked=true for that row.

marketplace-bot: added listing_id and sku_id metadata to the export.

mike-sales: uploading cleaned CSVs now: https://drive.redwood.ai/partners/vega-stratus-2787654321.csv

anya-eng: running dry-run ingest: output:
[ingest] parsed 14 rows
[ingest] resolved bid_ladder_type for 13/14
[ingest] computed spot_90pct for 4 rows
[ingest] masked 1 row for NDA -> price_masked=true

jess-finance: If all data in by 17:30 I'll run scenario sweeps tonight (reserved-heavy, spot-dominant, auction-fallback) and share P&L deltas tomorrow. Use max billing_lag_days when ranges present.

omar-ops: I'll add a short playbook note: default smoothing = linear 30d for commit cliffs; immediate preemptible fallback after grace window unless partner supports prorated conversion.

zoe-partners: Action items: Mike -> finish CSV uploads; Anya -> run final ingest and report errors; Omar -> update playbook; Jess -> run scenarios if full data present. Legal/PR to review aggregated ranges. Thanks :thumbsup:
